title: Daniel Short for Android
subtitle: A mobile companion for my projects, tools, and games.
metaDescription: Explore the Daniel Short Android app, including native navigation and tools, offline project summaries, and a current review APK download.
imageAlt: Screens from the Daniel Short Android app showing its native interface.
problem: The website works on phones, but I wanted faster access to projects and useful tools in a familiar Android interface.
task: Build an Android companion that keeps the portfolio easy to explore while offering useful native features and a reliable update path.
actions: Built navigation, search, bookmarks, settings, and selected tools in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
Added offline project summaries and native alternatives while keeping first-party website case studies, demos, and games available in the app.
Published a review APK through a versioned feed that identifies the approved file and supports verified in-app updates.
results: An installable Android review build supports Android 8 and newer.
Published project content can refresh from the website feed; changes to native code arrive through a signed app update.

personalStory.why: I wanted the site to feel useful on my own phone, with Android navigation and tools alongside the portfolio.
personalStory.surprise: Sharing content with the website was simpler than sharing behavior; native features and website experiences need different update paths.
personalStory.next: I’d continue refining the native alternatives and prepare a stable distribution channel.

notes: This is a review-channel APK for direct installation, not a Play Store release. The page checks the public release feed for the current download.
